threads.title: Community Guidelines
threads.body:
Our community works best when everyone feels safe to ask, share and learn.

Core guidelines:
1. Be respectful — assume good intent and disagree constructively.
2. No spam, self-promotion or off-topic promotions.
3. Protect each other's privacy — do not post personal data.
4. Flag content you believe breaks these rules with the reason provided.

Moderators review every report. Thank you for keeping this space healthy.

threads.title: Monthly AMA Schedule
threads.body:
Join leadership for an open Ask-Me-Anything on the last Thursday of every month at 16:00.

Upcoming AMAs:

- Course roadmap with the Learning team
- Mentorship programme Q&A with community managers
- Security & data practices with the trust team

Questions are collected in advance through the shared form and live during the session.
